name: Ode i devochki
source:
This is a lighthearted and mostly humorous story based on 7DL. It retells the familiar scenes from a different angle as it is read from the perspective of the girls.

[Edited and translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=825731376]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个基于7DL的轻松且幽默的故事。它从女孩的角度来阅读，从不同的角度重述了熟悉的场景。

[编辑和翻译自 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=825731376]Steam[/url]]
